name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter, descriptor=18_init). The '18' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are valid domain IDs), not an address residue (address 0x335DA contains no '18'). Name accurately reflects purpose as the chapter-18 init handler dispatched from the chapter-init table.
purpose: Chapter 18 (遙遠的彼岸) init handler: re-inits battle state, plays a 3-page dialog prologue chained with two cutscenes (event ids 0x36/0x37, each preceded by a camera pan to (0x10,4)), then clears facings and pans the camera to char 0.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); plays dialog page 0 then resets data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=0; pans camera-and-window to (0x10,4); fires cutscene 0x36; plays dialog page 1 then resets battle_anim_phase=0; pans camera-and-window to (0x10,4) again; fires cutscene 0x37; plays dialog page 2 (no anim_phase reset, it is the tail); then fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(); fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0). No portrait load, no char init (party carried over from previous chapter). In the binary the tail (page-2 dialog + clear-facing + pan-to-char) is emitted as a tail-JMP into the shared epilogue at 0x3310C owned by fd2_chapter_05_init; the straight-line source is the functionally-equivalent Layer-2 reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect orchestration of the chapter-18 opening sequence.

notes: Source comment block (chinit.c lines 1024-1057) is accurate, precise, and ASCII (legitimate Chinese exceptions: chapter title 遙遠的彼岸 and the 黑暗騎士/擊殺...勝利條件 game-content note). It correctly documents the dialog/cutscene sequence, the anim_phase reset pattern, the linked End (0x23CD5) and Post-action (0x208CF) handlers, and the 0x3310C tail-JMP into fd2_chapter_05_init's shared epilogue. Decompilation, callees (__CHK, fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter, fd2_display_dialog_scene, fd2_pan_cursor_and_window, fd2_cutscene_event_trigger), and the source body all match; clear_all_chars_facing/pan_cursor_to_char live in the shared epilogue (consistent with the documented tail-JMP). Sole xref is DATA from 0x51DB5 (chapter-init dispatch table) — 0 direct callers, as expected. Ghidra plate is a compact, consistent version of the same content. No source edit and no plate change needed.
